_comment: Known, explained differences. ceGl: CE vs GL glyph count (run.mjs). mathjaxCount / mathjaxMatch: MathJax vs LaTeX glyph count / matcher label agreement (engine.parity.ts). Keys are the corpus LaTeX strings.

exceptions.ceGl: CE merges the ffi ligature (4 glyphs); the GL template disables ligatures (6)
exceptions.mathjaxCount: CE only: ffi ligature (MathJax has no ligatures, like GL)

exceptions.ceGl: CE merges the fl ligature (3 glyphs); the GL template disables ligatures (4)
exceptions.mathjaxCount: CE only: fl ligature (MathJax has no ligatures, like GL)
CE only: amsmath builds \iint from two ∫ glyphs; MathJax draws one ∬ (like GL)
exceptions.ceGl: the GL template loads wasysym, whose \iint is one glyph (GL 10); amsmath's is two ∫ (CE 11)

exceptions.mathjaxCount: Tall delimiter: TeX and MathJax assemble it from different numbers of pieces (brackets: TeX 2 per side, MathJax 3)

exceptions.latex: \det \begin{vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{vmatrix} = ad - bc
exceptions.mathjaxCount: Tall delimiter: TeX and MathJax assemble it from different numbers of pieces (TeX stacks repeated | extenders)
Tall delimiter: TeX and MathJax assemble it from different numbers of pieces (TeX stacks repeated | extenders)
Tall delimiter: TeX and MathJax assemble it from different numbers of pieces (parentheses)
TeX draws \neq as / overlaid on = (2 glyphs); MathJax draws one ≠
Stretchy arrow: TeX assembles \overrightarrow from minus signs and an arrowhead
Stretchy brace: TeX and MathJax assemble it from different pieces
